findings: When SCIENTIFIC_SLOT_OCCUPIED_READBACK_MISSING meets a resumable pre-freeze orphan, evaluate_forge_run sets RESUME_BASE with GENERATED_DRAFT_READBACK instead of leaving START_BASE. persist_generated_draft rejects a physical path before slot admission.

The capability-repair test freezes only the exact draft, keeps one reservation, and asserts forge-run next_action RESUME_BASE without SCIENTIFIC_SLOT_OCCUPIED_READBACK_MISSING. A frozen session does not gain the exception. THIS_REPAIR_DOES_NOT_CREATE_A_NEW_SCIENTIFIC_LOOK. EXACT_GENERATED_DRAFT_RECOVERY_ONLY.

Clearing the missing-readback block now binds RESUME, so it does not fall through to a new BASE trial. The existing reservation stays the only occupancy for that slot and is not rewritten to the recovery capability epoch.
